visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a wet, asphalt road sloping downward, flanked by massive cherry blossom trees in dense, pink bloom. Two figures holding umbrellas are walking away from the camera in the distance. The lighting is diffused and grey, indicating an overcast, rainy day in a residential area. (2) A new angle shows a bright red pedestrian bridge, the Sakurabashi, crossing over the road. Two people with transparent umbrellas stand on the bridge, surrounded by soft pink sakura petals. (3) A close-up focuses on a weathered grey stone pillar at the edge of the bridge, featuring vertically engraved Japanese characters. The background is a soft-focus blur of pink blossoms and green foliage. (4) The camera shifts back to the street level, showing a cyclist in dark clothing riding down the lane. Road signs, including a 30 km/h speed limit, are visible on the left. (5) From an elevated perspective, the camera looks down onto the road where a black car and a silver van are driving slowly. Pedestrians with umbrellas walk along the narrow sidewalks under the thick canopy of trees. (6) A close-up of a vertical wooden signpost shows black calligraphy and smaller hiragana characters. The wood is dark and wet from the rain. (7) The final shot returns to the original wide perspective of the sakura-lined street, now empty of vehicles, highlighting the contrast between the pink flowers and the wet grey road.
